name: Danny Dwyer
tagline: NYC-based filmmaker. The lens doesn't care who's famous — it cares what's true.
introCopy:
I'm Danny Dwyer, or sometimes referred to as Dwyski, a NYC-based filmmaker. I direct, shoot, and cut, and I've done it full time for a solid 15 years with no safety net. I was born and raised in Ohio, and with me I brought the Midwest work ethic; respect and understanding for everyone on set, first-to-show-up, and last-to-leave. Fourteen years in New York City taught me a bit of everything; directing, lighting, shooting, and editing. Then came a decade in Los Angeles where it all came together.

My camera has been pointed at A-list celebrities, dudes serving life sentences, pop icons, and people like you and me. The lens doesn't care who's famous. It cares what's true. That's what I chase. The real thing, beautifully lit, with an intention to always serve the story.

Along the way my work made its way to several premieres from Cannes to Cleveland, campaigns for Google, PUMA, Columbia, ELLE, and Harper's Bazaar. I have worked with everyone from Lady Gaga to Beck, from Post Malone to the neighborhood postman.

Got a story worth telling? I want to hear it.
